faqs.question: Does Speech-to-text & audio transcriber upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Speech-to-text & audio transcriber executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using moonshine-tiny-en. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Speech-to-text & audio transcriber?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/voice_transcribe.json or open /tools/voice-transcribe?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
